SponsorAsset.title: SponsorAsset
SponsorAsset.description: Permanently uploaded sponsor logo or flyer image stored on the Firebase server and referenced by URL in Google Sheets.

assetId.description: Unique identifier for the uploaded image asset.

fileName.description: Sanitized original filename of the uploaded sponsor image.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the uploaded image.

imageData.description: Encoded binary payload of the uploaded image stored on the Firebase server.

sponsorName.description: Optional sponsor name associated with the uploaded image.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the image was uploaded.

/sponsor_assets/{assetId}.description: Publicly readable, immutable uploaded sponsor logo and flyer images.
